geometry: linear adjacent 1.00 Angstrom; neutral singlet STO-3G

inputs.H2: reuse saved Pauli Hamiltonian and raw state from non_df_h2_pilot; independently bound full-H reference on that ray
inputs.H6: saved available snapshot is DF-only, without original non-DF MO integrals; generate one new RHF/STO-3G MO integral set, Pauli-JW and common sector ground state, cross-check FCI; no DF generation
inputs.sector: Nalpha=Nbeta=molecule_size/2, interleaved alpha/beta, Qiskit little endian
inputs.normalization: raw binary64 state and exact common squared norm; no renormalization between methods

initial_selection.B0_H2: all prefixes 1..14 times q; full prefix separately labelled PF
initial_selection.B0_H6: unique prefixes {1, all-Z boundary, boundary+1, round(.25*m), round(.5*m), round(.75*m), round(.9*m), m-8, m-4, m}; all q
initial_selection.PR: prefixes {0, round(.25*m), all-Z boundary, boundary+1, round(.5*m), round(.75*m)} clipped below m; q skeleton r4/K4; K2 at q1/4/8; r2/8 at boundary and mid prefix, q1/4/8
initial_selection.prices: only joint eligible at one of five precisions; 8 paired exploration trajectories per PR candidate; deterministic once

adaptive_rules.B0: per precision top two eligible candidates and eligibility boundaries; prefix neighbours +/-1,+/-4 and midpoint to neighbouring evaluated prefix; q neighbours; at most 48 new configurations per round per molecule
adaptive_rules.PR: per precision top two exploration-G candidates; one-coordinate prefix +/-1,+/-4 and q/r neighbours or K toggle; at most 32 new configurations per round per molecule
adaptive_rules.second_round_trigger: previous improvement >1 percent, unresolved boundary or candidate/deterministic gap within five exploration SE
adaptive_rules.registration: each concrete batch JSON and code/input SHA fixed before calls; initial/adaptive records separate

confirmation.finalists: freeze union of top two exploration candidates per precision, at most 10; exploration nominees retained separately from confirmation-set minimum
confirmation.extend_if: important comparison within two combined SE and nominal t95 relative halfwidth >1 percent; no strict tail or sequential-CI claim
confirmation.seed_rule: SeedSequence([20261025,molecule_size,L_D,q,r,K,cohort_tag,index]); exploration=101, confirmation=202; uint64 to existing PCG64 sampler

numerics.target: actual finite effective uniform53 grid event law; exact retained coefficient*time operands and native binary64 step scalar; B_saved applied once
numerics.reference: full-H raw-state Duhamel enclosure from validated residual and Arb exp(-i*T*E); no midpoint-only reference
numerics.state_actions: matrix-free binary64 centers with explicit L2 roundoff propagation; Arb scalar trig and probability mass conversion; artificial comparison to existing dense Arb oracle
numerics.accounting: reuse H4 outward shot formula, alpha_axis=.025, epsilon/sqrt(2), u/headroom<=.01; rho=0 hypothetical; actual rho and PR population tail unknown
numerics.fallback: if a relevant numerical threshold unresolved, existing Arb vector bridge 64/96/128 as needed; do not use an invented allowance

scope: new inputs if needed, per-molecule reference, finite registered B0/full-PF/PR means, eligible compiled paired prices, adaptive batches, independent confirmation, saved-value accounting and combined H2/H4/H6 tables
technical_failures: preserve failed outputs; repair within scope under new code SHA and fresh attempt; reuse successful results; never reopen old fixed one-shot/STOP
stop: complete published results or unresolved major scientific premise; no other geometry/molecule, DF search, algorithm change, detailed science review or formal certificate acceptance
